name: Receptor-independent PI3K/AKT activation including oncogenic PI3K
rationale: All members concern positive or constitutive PI3K/AKT signaling driven by intracellular regulators or mutant PI3K, unlike confusables where specific receptors (MET, ALK/LTK, FGFR) feed the cascade.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8 sensing
name: CD1 lipid antigen presentation and TLR7/8 sensing
rationale: Members cover antigen presentation with emphasis on CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigens plus TLR7/TLR8, distinguishing it from MHC class II peptide presentation and monocyte/DC surface signature confusables.

name: CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPase signaling
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and effectors of CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPases (RND2/3, RHOD, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV) acting via formins and IQGAPs, whereas confusables add the RAC and RHOA/B/C cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors.

core: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and kinetochore attachment
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment and midzone elongation
rationale: All members concern spindle-kinetochore attachment, spindle assembly checkpoint signaling and anaphase spindle elongation/midzone, distinct from cytokinesis and PLK1/AURKA mitotic-entry confusables.

name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, vessel remodeling, wound healing and angiogenic proliferation, unlike confusables centred on FGF/VEGF production, smooth muscle migration or monocyte activation.

name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic adaptation and sarcomere growth
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization, distinguishing the theme from skeletal muscle atrophy, heart contraction and calcineurin/stress-hypertrophy confusables.

name: BAX/BAK-mediated mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
rationale: Members concern BAX/BAK activation, BH3-only neutralization of BCL-2 and regulation of MOMP and cytochrome c release, upstream of the apoptosome/SMAC confusables and distinct from BH3-only translocation confusables.

name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, nitrogen balance
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, proline, ornithine, arginine, aspartate and GABA metabolism with ammonium homeostasis, without the urea cycle enzyme defects, amino acid transport or glyoxylate/glycine content of confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I recognition by NK receptors
name: NK cell MHC class I recognition and cytotoxicity regulation
rationale: Members concern NK receptor (KIR) signatures, MHC class I/Ib-dependent inhibition and regulation of NK cytotoxicity and tolerance, distinguishing it from T cell activation and DC/T cell tolerance confusables.

name: Glycan elongation and sialylation of glycoproteins and glycosphingolipids
rationale: Members cover complex/hybrid N-glycan and O-GalNAc glycan elongation, sialic acid supply, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, unlike confusables on early N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport or fucosylation.

qualifier: long- to medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase spirals
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation spirals of long- to medium-chain acyl-CoAs
rationale: All members are acyl-CoA dehydrogenase-driven mitochondrial beta-oxidation steps from C16 to C8, lacking the carnitine shuttle, ketone body and peroxisomal oxidation content of confusables.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide and deoxyribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members concern breakdown of deoxyribonucleotides (dCMP, dGMP) and deoxyribonucleosides across purines and pyrimidines, unlike confusables limited to purine or pyrimidine metabolism or ribonucleotide catabolism.

name: Cardiac chamber wall, septum and endocardium morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern atrial/ventricular myocardium, trabeculae, septa, endocardium and coronary vessel morphogenesis, distinct from early heart tube/second heart field, valve and conduction system confusables.

name: ATF6/CREB3-driven ER unfolded protein response and UPR regulation
rationale: Members cover ATF6/CREB3 chaperone induction, ER overload and regulation of IRE1/PERK signaling and ER stress apoptosis, while confusables carry ATF4/XBP1 and translational control arms.

name: Left/right asymmetry determination via extracellular Nodal/BMP antagonism
rationale: Members concern left/right axis specification in organs and lateral mesoderm with Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration, distinct from planar polarity, somitogenesis, gastrulation and motile cilium assembly confusables.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and RNA methylation and pseudouridylation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation plus tRNA/rRNA/mRNA methylation, thiolation and pseudouridylation, without the wybutosine, t6A, tRNA processing or mitochondrial tRNA processing content of confusables.

name: NADPH-generating metabolism in oxidative stress and ferroptosis defense
rationale: Members link ROS, p53 and NFE2L2 regulation of pentose phosphate, TCA/isocitrate and glycolytic metabolism to NADPH regeneration and ferroptosis control, unlike confusables on other NFE2L2 targets, ROS detoxification or hypoxia-driven glycolysis.

qualifier: APP metabolism, tau tangles and microglia
name: APP metabolism, tau tangle and microglial activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid precursor protein synthesis/catabolism, neurofibrillary tangle assembly and microglial activation, distinct from amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance/astrocyte confusables.

name: Norepinephrine transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: All members concern norepinephrine uptake by the SLC6A2 transporter, unlike adrenergic receptor, dopamine, serotonin and GABA transport confusables.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling axis and noncoding-RNA control of PTEN
rationale: Members concern PTEN restraint of PI3K/AKT, oncogenic AKT1/PTEN loss and ceRNA/lncRNA regulation of PTEN, distinguishing it from PTEN stability, ERBB2/3, TORC2 and nuclear phosphoinositide confusables.

name: Intraflagellar transport and cilium assembly/disassembly control
rationale: Members cover anterograde/retrograde IFT and regulation of cilium assembly, disassembly and centriole elongation, distinct from ciliary cargo targeting and basal body/centrosome confusables.

qualifier: with carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members span carnitine shuttle, the full mitochondrial beta-oxidation spiral to acetyl-CoA and ketone body synthesis/use, unlike confusables on carnitine transport defects or peroxisomal and alpha-oxidation.

core: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage in adipogenesis
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation and fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation and adipocyte programs, whereas confusables carry lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride catabolism.

name: Aquaglyceroporin glycerol and urea membrane transport
rationale: All members concern transmembrane transport of glycerol and urea through aquaglyceroporins, distinct from vasopressin-regulated water transport, glycerol metabolism and fatty acid transport confusables.

name: GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation
rationale: All members concern GABA synthesis, secretion, uptake and catabolism, unlike glutamate transport, glycine/lysine catabolism and vesicular loading confusables.
